purpose: エリア画面の連続シーン背景。4つのホットスポット（①管理棟/プランニング室 14-18%左, ②ガントリークレーン 38-42%, ③検数ブース/ゲート 60-65%, ④配車場/トラック列 80-84%）が乗る
scene: A container terminal at blue hour (just after sunset, sky still deep blue with warm orange horizon), seen as one continuous miniature clay diorama, left to right: a small glowing planning office; a tall gantry crane lifting a container from a docked cargo ship; a small checking booth by a gate; a truck area with ONE toy truck waiting (keep this area simple and readable). Warm floodlights, calm sea. Cozy, safe, clearly lit workplace with tiny helmeted worker figures — bright enough that every element reads at small sizes.
composition: Wide horizontal scene, slight high angle. Four work areas at roughly 16%/40%/62%/80% of the width. IMPORTANT: leave at least 8% empty margin on BOTH left and right edges — no building or truck may touch the frame edge. Sky top 25%. Moderate contrast so dark areas stay readable when scaled down.
required_objects: gantry crane with a hanging container
forbidden_objects: elements touching the left or right edge
dense clutter at the truck area
